sectionDescription: Follow the lives of Animal HQ's undercover agents through the 'My Name Is...' series of short stories, then continue the journey in the full-length Animal Intelligence novels, where animals build their own civilization.

books.title: My name is Nacho
books.description:
A novel about the first mission of Nacho, a second-generation secret animal agent. Through Nacho’s journey, we explore what it means to be human and the relationships that shape us.

Coming in early December!
